title: Version 20 Rocket Launch Game
author: Jumpy-Firefighter500
selftext:
I have made some improvements to the previous version based on feedback. I want reviews on this. This is just a pet project of mine.

It is not a complete game yet. Just an overview. The objective is to destroy the enemy planet.

The sound effects and the animation (especially of the planet being destroyed) is not according to my own liking as of yet. I am using AI to code it.

Any suggestions and feedback is welcome.

The aim currently is to destroy the enemy planet with the given number of rockets. You control and send off these rockets one by one or all together if you can manage it.

Link: https://www.mrcsedge.com/rocketgame
